title: friendsframe
summary: The social window is substantially complete: FriendsFrame four-piece art shell, Friends/Who/Guild/Raid tabs, Friends/Ignore inset toggle, friend rows (10, matching the reference count) with online status, level/class/zone, ignore rows (20, matching), name input with Add Friend / Ignore Player, Remove Friend / Stop Ignore, Group Invite, Who list with column headers, search box, refresh, add-friend/invite from results, and count-of-total footer. All 10 registry opcodes hit.
